title: Veda Parichayam-3
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: The name ‘Veda’ is given to the vast body of literature made up of Mantra and Brahmana. So far we have been referring mostly to Mantras which constitute the Samhita portion of the Veda, now we go to the Brahmanas. Brahmanas are most important among several other texts, which were composed in ancient times to explain the difficult meaning and secret knowledge of the Vedic Samhitas.Meaning of the Term ‘Brahmana’The word Brahmana in neuter gender means Brahmana texts.
